messages:
andrea: Heads-up — we're planning an RBAC sweep + audit log hardening for the on-prem/private deploys next Tues. Main ask: how do teams want KMS fallback behaviour in air-gapped sites? Prefer fail-closed (deny) or queued decrypt requests to a remote broker? cc @mike @sophie

mike: Strong prefer fail-closed for customer data, but we need a graceful path for control-plane metadata. If we deny, some controlplane ops will break. Can we have a local sealing key that allows read-only ops? :thinking:

sophie: Also need to think about incident response — if KMS rotation happens we must be able to revoke ephemeral tokens without losing observability. What's the plan for audit logs if KMS endpoint unreachable?

andrea: Proposal: primary KMS = HSM/KMS with local network access. Fallback policy = don't decrypt -> return 503 for serving requests; for admin/control-plane ops, queue to local durable store and alert @ops-oncall. Rationale: minimize silent fallback and avoid accidental data exposure.

mike: Example netpol to enforce egress-only-to-kms + monitoring endpoints:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: restrict-egress-to-kms
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: model-server
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.10.42.0/24 # kms subnet
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          team: infra
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

mike: Also run this quick check to validate audit writes on nodes:
```
kubectl exec -n infra $(kubectl get pod -n infra -l app=audit-relay -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- tail -n 50 /var/log/redwood/audit.log
```

andrea: For airgapped sites we will deploy an audit-forwarder that writes append-only logs to disk + signed manifest. Shipping schedule: manual usb courier or secure sftp pull from staging-bastion. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-rbac-rotation

ops-oncall: If we return 503 on decrypt, auto-trigger the canary rollback policy (see infra/rollout) so customer-facing endpoints degrade gracefully. Also add an immediate PagerDuty alert to sec-oncall.

ci-bot: Deploy job queued: rbac-sweep/2026-03-25 — linting netpol + unit tests. Will report status here.

sophie: +1 to queued durable store for control-plane ops. Also request we record a "rotation window" header in audit logs when KMS is unreachable so we can correlate.

andrea: Timeline: staging T+7 days, prod T+21 days. I'll open PR with config + a small e2e test. Thanks everyone :clap:
